import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/builtin.c","function":"f_string_implode","line":1344,"var":"a","code":"if (jv_get_kind(a) != JV_KIND_ARRAY) return ret_error(...);","note":"Attacker-controlled filter input reaches implode/1 and must be an array to continue."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/builtin.c","function":"f_string_implode","line":1350,"var":"s","code":"jv s = jv_string_empty(len);","note":"implode allocates an empty string with length equal to the array length, even when the array is empty."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/jv.c","function":"jvp_string_empty_new","line":1147,"var":"s->data","code":"memset(s->data, 0, length);","note":"For length 0, the buffer is left without an explicit NUL terminator byte."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/jv.c","function":"jv_string_append_codepoint","line":1516,"var":"a","code":"a = jvp_string_append(a, buf, len);","note":"Subsequent string construction paths assume the empty string is NUL-terminated and append via C-string semantics."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/jv.c","function":"jv_string_value","line":1490,"var":"jvp_string_ptr(j)->data","code":"return jvp_string_ptr(j)->data;","note":"The resulting string data is exposed as a C string to later formatting/printing code, enabling an out-of-bounds read/write when the terminator is missing."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
PY
